name: go-tc-aef39bed-blind30-ots
instr:
# go-tc: garbled traffic-control settings, diagnosed without a test suite

The repository has received 30 separate undocumented edits. What follows is everything we have been able to observe from the outside.

We use this to tell the kernel how an interface should queue, shape and sort the packets going through it, and it now gets a great deal of that wrong. Nothing about the kernel changed and nothing about our calling code changed. Settings we hand over and read straight back come out altered or blank, and a number of requests now succeed or fail for the wrong reason.

Describing a queue and reading it back no longer returns what went in. One given a target, a limit, an interval, an ECN flag and a threshold comes back with the interval gone and the other four intact. A related kind, given target, limit, interval, ECN, flow count, quantum, threshold, drop batch size and memory limit, comes back without the limit. A third, given a backlog limit, quantum, flow limit, reset and eviction timeouts, admitted bytes and a weight, comes back without the backlog limit. Installing any of the three on an interface and listing it back shows the same field missing.

A queue described by an mtu and a rate together with a burst comes back additionally carrying a peak burst of zero nobody asked for, and one described with a peak burst instead loses it; separately, decoding a payload of that same kind hands back an entirely empty value with no complaint, so nothing survives the trip at all. A
